items.title: NSE’s IPO Pricing Leaves Unlisted Share Buyers Facing Losses - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investors who piled into National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.’s shares ahead of its initial public offering face potential losses, with the bourse expected to price the deal at a discount to levels its stock traded in the private market.
